scientific_integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically from Alspach's arc-pancyclicity theorem plus an explicit layer-splicing construction. Finite computations are used only as stress tests. Originality searches found no covering statement, but older composition literature remains a residual terminology risk.
scientific_limitations: Sufficient-condition theorem for equal independent-set blow-ups of regular tournaments; it does not classify arbitrary regular multipartite tournaments or unequal blow-ups. The case of a three-vertex regular base tournament is excluded because its nontrivial equal blow-ups are not arc-pancyclic.
title: Arc-pancyclic equal blow-ups of regular tournaments
